reviews.review_text: The best thing I liked about the online MBA course at NMIMS was the extended course duration. Due to some issues, I dropped out for a year, but later on managed to complete my program within a span of 3 years.
For me NMIMS online MBA was up to the mark and met all my expectations. However, there is a little scope for improvement, but overall, I had a good experience.
I recently graduated from the NMIMS online MBA program, and it is a worthwhile option due to its minimal interaction with faculty and self paced learning facility.
The online MBA course at Narsee Monjee also offers career services that I liked the most, and on behalf of it, I recommend it to others too.

faqs.question: What are the eligibility criteria for the NMIMS Online MBA in Business Management program?
faqs.answer: The eligibility criteria for the NMIMS Online MBA in Business Management program require a valid bachelor's degree with at least 50% aggregate marks.

faqs.question: Is the NMIMS Online MBA in Business Management degree recognized by UGC and other regulatory bodies?
faqs.answer: Yes, the NMIMS Online MBA in Business Management degree is recognized by NAAC A+, AIU, BCI, NCTE, and UGC.

faqs.question: How are the classes conducted for the NMIMS Online MBA in Business Management course?
faqs.answer: The NMIMS Online MBA in Business Management course classes are conducted completely online via LMS (Learning Management System).

faqs.question: What is the fee structure for the NMIMS Online MBA in Business Management program?
faqs.answer: The fee structure for the NMIMS Online MBA in Business Management program is INR 55,000 /- per semester.

faqs.question: What are the career opportunities after completing the NMIMS Online MBA in Business Management?
faqs.answer: The career opportunities after completing the NMIMS Online MBA in Business Management include Policy Analyst, Director of Business Development, Business Development Manager, etc.

data.placement_content:
To offer a promising professional career ahead for students enrolled in the NMIMS online MBA course, the university offers dedicated placement assistance with personalized career services. They have witnessed a 40% improvement in the profile ranking of enrolled students and provide 6 months of access to relevant opportunities via job portals like Updazz, IIMJobs, and Hirist.

The career services offered under the NMIMS online MBA placement assistance are:

  • Job portal access.
  • Career coaching.
  • Practice interviews.
  • Profile development (CV guidance, LinkedIn optimization, etc).

These career services also provide AI-powered personalized recommendations to boost your profile based on company insights. The university has 500+ hiring partners with 20000+ recruiters shaping students' careers. Some of the leading hiring partners include:

  • ICICI Securities
  • Oracle
  • WIPRO BPO

data.eligibility_content:
The eligibility criteria for the NMIMS online MBA course are as follows:

The interested candidate must have completed a bachelor's degree with a 10+2+3 educational qualification from a recognized university.

The applicant must have scored a minimum of 50% aggregate marks at the graduation level (45% for reserved category students, SC/ST/OBC/PwD).
data.admission_steps:
To enroll in the NMIMS online MBA course, follow the below listed step-by-step admission process for a hassle-free enrollment procedure:

Step 1. Visit the official website of NMIMS Online and register.

Step 2. Complete the registration process to receive credentials to access the admission portal.

Step 3. Start filling out the application form with accurate information.

Step 4. Attach the supporting documents and submit the NMIMS online MBA application form.

Step 5. The university will verify the application form, documents, and fee.

Step 6. Once the verification is completed, the university will issue a "student number" and dispatch your study kit along with the activation of the student portal and LMS.

data.about_content:
NMIMS Online MBA in Business Management is developed to provide aspiring business professionals with an in-depth understanding of core business disciplines, including management, law, economics, and marketing. The program develops the essential skills students need in today's challenging business environments to think strategically and take action.

The NMIMS online MBA in business management course offers a strong base in different concepts, aspects, and subjects of business management and growth economics. The course combines management practices and theories with marketing, economics, accounting, and finance to solve complex business problems.

To ensure future success, the NMIMS online MBA in business management provides access to a job portal, career coaching, profile development, and several other personalized career assistance services to enrolled students. The program's core part consists of 800+ hours of live and interactive sessions. Simultaneously, students can study at their own pace, which makes it an ideal course for working professionals and students with other commitments.

data.emi_content: Students can opt for flexible EMI options ranging from 3 to 12 months. The NMIMS online MBA in business management EMI starts from INR 8,750/-. EMI facility is available through HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Axis Bank, Citibank, Standard Chartered Bank, HSBC Bank, and Kotak Mahindra Bank.
data.exam_content:
The NMIMS online courses examination process is similar for both UG and PG programs. The exams are conducted through an online proctored platform that allows students to appear for the examinations from any corner of the globe; they only need a good internet connection, a laptop, and a working webcam.

The NMIMS online examinations follow an evaluation method of IA + TEE, which stands for Internal Assessment + Term End Examinations.

data.syllabus_content:
The NMIMS online MBA in business management syllabus follows a semester pattern that develops the required leadership skills among the students and helps them understand the global competitive business environment. For a better course understanding, the detailed course syllabus is mentioned below:

Year I

Semester I

  • Business Communication
  • Financial Accounting
  • Micro Economics & Macro Economics
  • Organisational Behaviour
  • Marketing Management
  • Quantitative Methods – I

Semester II

  • Cost & Management Accounting
  • Human Resource Management
  • Strategic Management
  • Business Analytics
  • Legal Aspect of Business
  • Operations Management

Year II

Semester III

  • Corporate Finance
  • Research Methodology
  • Project Pre-work
  • Information Systems for Management
  • Consumer Behaviour
  • Organisational Theory, Structure and Design
  • Supply Chain Management

Semester IV

  • Indian Ethos and Ethics
  • Corporate Sustainability
  • International Business
  • Project
  • Digital Marketing
  • Entrepreneurship and Venture Capital Management
  • Project Management
